choice.title: STX menu bar app and tools
choice.description: The STX menu bar app (headphone impedance, input monitoring, DAC filter, de-emphasis), the stxctl command, and a copy of the kext for OpenCore in /Library/Application Support/CMI8788Driver.

choice.title: Driver (kext) in /Library/Extensions
choice.description: Installs CMI8788Driver.kext for loading by macOS. Needs SIP's kext signing check disabled. OpenCore users: untick this and add the kext to EFI/OC/Kexts instead (the app's "Show Kext for OpenCore" menu item finds it).
